canonical.title: Adversarial System Explorer
canonical.job: Explore how a system could be misused, manipulated, broken or exploited—and what blocks those paths.
canonical.bWeb: An attack graph changes as attacker goals and controls change.

interruptionRule: Every control in at least one declared set must be enabled and have one current passing evidence record.
nonClaims: Example goals and paths are not threat completeness.
Interrupted modeled paths do not prove control efficacy or absence of bypass, combined, adaptive, or unmodeled paths.
High-level defensive paths are not operational exploit guidance, penetration testing, security certification, safety, or compliance.
